rationale.consistency: Refactors trimPathPrefix into a shared matchPathPrefix helper in the same style; keeps existing comments, naming and error-comment conventions of the file.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles decoded pattern vs %xx path, literal % in pattern, case-insensitive hex, empty suffix, no-match, and avoids aligning a match inside an escape by skipping whole valid %xx sequences.
rationale.scope: Only suffix path changed; prefix behaviour preserved via delegation; removal of the now-unused reverse helper is warranted cleanup, nothing else touched.
rationale.readability: Clear names and helpful comments; the scan loop with manual advance, break-on-short and 3x length bound is a little dense but each step is explained.
rationale.robustness: All slice accesses are bounds-guarded; invalid escapes fall back to single-byte advance; no panics or new failure modes; changePath still syncs Path and RawPath.
rationale.maintainability: Prefix and suffix now share one matcher so rule changes apply to both; no duplication; O(n·m) scan is fine for URL paths.
